CeruleanCity_Text_CaveSealed.en: The grotto is sealed by a strange\nforce. Not yet...\pThe hall's north passage is open.
CeruleanCity_Text_CaveSealed.fr: La grotte est scellée par une force\nétrange. Pas encore…\pLe passage nord de la salle est\nouvert.

CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign.en:
TOURMALIA CITY
Where the forest grows crystal\pWEST:  ROUTE 4 (this road)
SOUTH: ROUTE 5 (ladder below)\pEAST:  ROUTE 9 (past the dome)
NORTH: ROUTE 24 (via glass hall)
CeruleanCity_Text_CitySign.fr:
TOURMALIA
Là où la forêt devient cristal\pOUEST : ROUTE 4 (cette route)
SUD : ROUTE 5 (échelle en bas)\pEST : ROUTE 9 (après le dôme)
NORD : ROUTE 24 (par le hall)

CeruleanCity_Text_EastTree.en: POLICEMAN: The roads are open\nagain. Head south to APATIA.\pThe east pass is blocked by a\nsmall tree. You'll need CUT.
CeruleanCity_Text_EastTree.fr: POLICIER : Les routes ont rouvert.\nVa vers le sud, à APATIA.\pLe col de l'est est bloqué par un\npetit arbre. Il te faudra COUPE.

CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel.en:
A chatty gossip like you…
That thing's perfect.\pI don't need it because I don't
give a hoot about others.\pAll right, this time I really am
gone. Smell ya!
CeruleanCity_Text_ExplainFameCheckerSmel.fr: C'est parfait pour une pipelette\ncomme toi.\pJ'en ai pas besoin parce que j'en\nai rien à faire des autres.\pAllez, j'suis plus là, tchao !

CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign.en: TOURMALIA POKéMON GYM\nLEADER: SYLVESTRE\lThe Warden of the Forest!
CeruleanCity_Text_GymSign.fr: ARÈNE POKéMON DE TOURMALIA\nCHAMPION : SYLVESTRE\lLe Gardien de la Forêt !

CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou.en: The police closed the south road\nand the east pass.\pOnly the bridge north is open,\nfor strong TRAINERS.
CeruleanCity_Text_IfSlowbroWasntThereCou.fr: La police a fermé la route du sud\net le col de l'est.\pSeul le pont au nord est ouvert,\npour les DRESSEURS costauds.

CeruleanCity_Text_NorthPolice.en: POLICEMAN: Halt! The bridge is\nclosed. TEAM ONYBRIS went that way.\pOnly TRAINERS proven strong enough\nmay pass. Earn the GYM's BADGE\pfrom SYLVESTRE first.
CeruleanCity_Text_NorthPolice.fr:
POLICIER : Halte ! Le pont est
fermé. La TEAM ONYBRIS est passée\ppar là.\pSeuls les DRESSEURS assez forts
peuvent passer. Gagne d'abord le\pBADGE de l'ARÈNE auprès de
SYLVESTRE.

CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs.en: Oh, yeah, right.\pI feel sorry for you. No, really.\nYou're always plodding behind me.\pSo here, I'll give you a little\npresent as a favor.
CeruleanCity_Text_OhRightLittlePresentAs.fr: Ouais, c'est ça…\pJ'ai les boules pour toi. J'te\njure, t'es toujours derrière moi.\pBon, j'vais te donner un cadeau,\nmais c'est une faveur.

CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu.en: You're making an encyclopedia on\nPOKéMON? That sounds amusing.
CeruleanCity_Text_PokemonEncyclopediaAmu.fr: Tu fais une encyclopédie sur les\nPOKéMON ? Pas mal.

CeruleanCity_Text_RefAfter.en: DANTE: Take good care of it. The\nnext REFUGE post is waiting.
CeruleanCity_Text_RefAfter.fr: DANTE : Prends-en bien soin. Le\nprochain poste du REFUGE t'attend.

CeruleanCity_Text_RefAsk.en: DANTE: The river is quiet. Too quiet.\nHunters set traps near the bridge\land I saw them with nets.
CeruleanCity_Text_RefAsk.fr: DANTE : La rivière est calme. Trop\ncalme. Des chasseurs ont posé des\ppièges près du pont, avec des\nfilets.

CeruleanCity_Text_RefDone.en: DANTE: Thank you again. The REFUGE\nis safer because of you.
CeruleanCity_Text_RefDone.fr: DANTE : Merci encore ! Le REFUGE\nest plus sûr grâce à toi.

CeruleanCity_Text_RefEarly.en: DANTE: Not yet. Finish the earlier\nposts first. The KEEPER at the\lSAFARI ZONE knows the order.
CeruleanCity_Text_RefEarly.fr: DANTE : Pas encore ! Finis d'abord\nles postes précédents. Le GARDIEN\pdu PARC SAFARI connaît l'ordre.

CeruleanCity_Text_RefGives.en: DANTE: You saved the day. The post\nhas a gift for you: BAGON!
CeruleanCity_Text_RefGives.fr: DANTE : T'as sauvé la mise. Le\nposte a un cadeau pour toi :\pDRABY !

CeruleanCity_Text_RefHunter1.en: HUNTER: Rare ones fetch a fortune!\nStay out of this, child!
CeruleanCity_Text_RefHunter1.fr: CHASSEUR : Les rares valent une\nfortune ! Ne te mêle pas de ça,\ppetit !

CeruleanCity_Text_RefHunter2.en: HUNTER: You beat my partner? Fine,\nI am not afraid of a ranger!
CeruleanCity_Text_RefHunter2.fr: CHASSEUR : T'as battu mon\nassocié ? Soit, j'ai pas peur\ld'un ranger !

CeruleanCity_Text_RefIdle.en: DANTE: I watch over the animals here.\nThe world is quieter now.
CeruleanCity_Text_RefIdle.fr: DANTE : Je veille sur les animaux\nici. Tout est plus calme\pmaintenant.

CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro.en: {RIVAL}: Hold it, {PLAYER}!\pThe police closed the bridge to\nanyone who isn't strong enough.\pThe ONYBRIS thieves went that way.\nI won't have you slow me down.\pShow me you can handle it!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalIntro.fr: {RIVAL} : Stop, {PLAYER} !\pLa police a fermé le pont à tous\nceux qui sont pas assez forts.\pLes voleurs d'ONYBRIS sont passés\npar là. Je te laisserai pas me\pralentir.\pMontre-moi que t'en es capable !

CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle.en: {RIVAL}: Hmph. Not bad.\pThe ONYBRIS took the TOURMALINE\nand crossed the bridge north.\pI'm going after them. Keep up if\nyou can. Smell ya!
CeruleanCity_Text_RivalPostBattle.fr: {RIVAL} : Hmph. Pas mal.\pLes ONYBRIS ont pris la TOURMALINE\net ont traversé le pont au nord.\pJe les poursuis. Suis-moi si t'en\nes capable. À plus !

CeruleanCity_Text_RoadsClosed.en: POLICEMAN: TEAM ONYBRIS is loose.\nWe sealed every road out of town\pexcept the one to PYROPIA. The\nonly way on is the north bridge,\pand only for strong TRAINERS.
CeruleanCity_Text_RoadsClosed.fr:
POLICIER : La TEAM ONYBRIS est en
cavale. Toutes les routes sont\pscellées sauf celle de PYROPIA.
Le seul passage : le pont au nord,\pet seulement pour les DRESSEURS
forts.

CeruleanCity_Text_RoadsOpen.en: POLICEMAN: The south road is open\nagain. Stay safe out there!
CeruleanCity_Text_RoadsOpen.fr: POLICIER : La route du sud a\nrouvert. Sois prudent !

CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave.en:
This is TOURMALIA CAVE.\pHorribly strong POKéMON live inside
there.\pIt takes a very special TRAINER to
be allowed inside there.\pYou'd have to be strong enough to
become the POKéMON LEAGUE\lCHAMPION for starters.\pAnd, you would have to have
made a great achievement.
CeruleanCity_Text_ThisIsCeruleanCave.fr:
Voici la GROTTE TOURMALIA.\pDes POKéMON terriblement forts y
vivent.\pIl faut un DRESSEUR bien spécial
pour avoir le droit d'y entrer.\pIl faudrait déjà être assez fort
pour devenir CHAMPION de la LIGUE\lPOKéMON.\pEt avoir accompli un grand exploit.

CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt.en: You're a TRAINER, too?\pCollecting, battling…\nIt's a tough life, isn't it?
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerLifeIsToughIsnt.fr: T'es un DRESSEUR aussi ?\pCapturer… Collectionner… Combattre…\nDur, hein ?

CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems.en: TRAINER TIPS\pA POKéMON can be made to hold\nan item.\pSome items can even be used by\nthe holding POKéMON in battle.
CeruleanCity_Text_TrainerTipsHeldItems.fr: ASTUCE\pLes POKéMON peuvent porter des\nobjets.\pCertains objets portés peuvent même\nêtre utilisés en combat.

CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle.en: I want a bright red bicycle.\pI'll keep it at home, so it won't\nget dirty.
CeruleanCity_Text_WantBrightRedBicycle.fr: Je veux une jolie bicyclette !\pJe la veux toute rouge !

CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree.en:
Did you know you can CUT down
small trees?\pThat tree in the east pass could
be cleared with CUT.\pI hear the captain of the S.S.
ANNE owns the HM.
CeruleanCity_Text_YouCanCutDownSmallTree.fr:
Tu savais que tu peux COUPER les
petits arbres ?\pL'arbre dans le col de l'est,
tu pourrais le couper avec COUPE.\pParaît que le capitaine du S.S.
ANNE a la CS.
